title: DRMD (Digital Reference Material Document) Guidance Document
description:
The guidance document for the Digital Reference Material Document (DRMD), the XML format for reference material certificates and product information sheets aligned with ISO 33401:2024. It explains every element of the DRMD XML Schema 1.0.0, with its business rules and examples, for reference material producers, laboratories, software developers and auditors: one chapter per part of the schema, the mapping to ISO 33401:2024, Table 1, implementation checklists for each role, and an interactive view of the schema. The DRMD reuses the Digital Calibration Certificate (DCC) and the Digital System of Units (D-SI) of PTB.

Content. The source of the website https://bamresearch.github.io/drmd-guidance/ (MkDocs), with the build configuration.
